title: Where the Third Test Bites
gallery_text: The lot view at the third test, at the published grant. Every dot that is still colored got past the rules and past the rear yard; the red ones are where the loan and the rent stop it.
description: One state, at the program's own numbers. The view is the lot view showing the third test, so the red dots are lots that had room for a unit and still do not work for the owner.
